description: List an app's, agent's, or skill's releases, newest first: each one's version, state, commit, and when it was created, and which one is active. A release that never went live is not listed. To roll back, read an earlier release's files with get_source and its release argument, then publish them again. A skill's release version is the version get_skill reports; read one with get_skill and its release argument. Websites are refused. Requires connecting a Valet account.

limit.description: How many releases to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

name.description: Required. The app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_releases
title: List releases
